title: Discord guild member list holds only a handful of users and fetching all members times out
symptoms: guild.members.cache.size is far below the server's member count
Error [GUILD_MEMBERS_TIMEOUT]: Members didn't arrive in time
List Guild Members returns an error or nothing for the bot
cause: Without the privileged GUILD_MEMBERS intent the gateway does not send the member list, so the cache holds only members seen in other events. The List Guild Members endpoint itself requires that intent.
fix: Enable Server Members Intent in the portal and request GuildMembers in code before fetching members. Prefer fetching the specific members you need over loading every member.
apply:
const client = new Client({ intents: [GatewayIntentBits.Guilds, GatewayIntentBits.GuildMembers] });
const members = await guild.members.fetch();
affected: Discord API v10 gateway; discord.js 12 and later
